newsList.title: 2025 Mass Leaderboard Retiming & Twitch VOD Deletion
newsList.body:
### Greetings, all! Lots to discuss today...

# 2025 Mass Leaderboard Retiming

Over the past few months, **MrPonytale** has been assessing the entirety of our leaderboard, frame counting every single submission, hunting for VOD reuploads and dead links, and keeping track of incorrect dates, version

threadList.name: Not a runner but a thing I use to do with my sister that would glitch and unlock all the levels and that chicken guy
Any particular reason why emulators are banned?

categories.rules:
Timer starts:

- when you enter a new file in Adventure. 

Goal:
-Collect everything from the T.T. menu (All 47 Balloons, All 4 keys, All 4 pieces of the T.T. Amulet, All 4 pieces of the Wizpig Amulet, All 4 Golden Trophies) and the Future Fun Land Golden Trophy. The extra balloon that is located OoB in the Smokey boss race can be collected but not substituted for any of the other 47 balloons.

Timer stops:

- after crossing the finish line at Wizpig 2. 

Conditions:

- Any character can be used, but T.T is recommended. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Wrong warp is allowed. Resetting to save time is allowed. Emulator is banned. Everdrive is banned.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Timer starts:

- when you enter a new file in Adventure. 

Goal:

- Beat the game

Timer stops:

- after crossing the finish line at Wizpig 2. 

- Conditions: 
Any character can be used, but T.T is recommended. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Wrong warp is allowed. Resetting to save time is allowed. Emulator is banned. Everdrive is banned.

categories.name: All Trophy Races
categories.rules: Complete all of the trophy races in track mode. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Wrong warp is not allowed, nor is useful in any way. Emulator is banned. Everdrive is banned. Freeze glitch is banned.

categories.name: Balloon Races
categories.rules: Races that are possible to do in the Adventure mode. The time you submit is the time that is last seen before the finish line. No magic codes allowed. Video is required. Pausing mid-race is not allowed. Emulator is banned.

categories.name: Time Trials 3-lap
categories.rules:
REMINDER: dkr64.com is where you should go if you want to do time trials!

Time Trial mode. The time you submit is the total time shown after the race.
- Shortcuts allowed
- video proof required
- pausing can lead to times being rejected, if any advantage was gained from it
- Emulator is banned.

categories.name: Time Trials Fast Lap
categories.rules:
REMINDER: dkr64.com is where you should go if you want to do time trials!

Time Trial mode. The time you submit is the time shown as fastest lap after the race.
- Shortcuts allowed
- video proof required
- pausing can lead to times being rejected, if any advantage was gained from it
- Emulator is banned.

categories.name: Any% Glitchless
categories.rules:
Complete Adventure 1 without using any of the glitches listed below.

**Banned Glitches**:

- Cutscene skips performed on the final frame of a race
- Any out-of-bounds clips performed by the runner specifically to gain an advantage over a race or the progression of the game
- Checkpoint manipulation in any form
- Trophy storage in any form
- Collectables not earned from their original source

Timer starts when you enter a new file in Adventure 1. Timer stops after crossing the finish line at Wizpig 2. Any character can be used, but T.T is recommended. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. Any version is allowed. Emulator is banned. Resetting the console is allowed. Restarting a race to skip its intro cutscene is not considered a glitch in the context of this category and is allowed. Moving or turning the character at the beginning of a minigame is not considered a glitch in the context of this category and is allowed.

categories.name: Trophy Races
categories.rules:
Complete the trophy race as fast as possible.

Must complete all of the races in the trophy race. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Wrong warp is not allowed, nor is it useful in any way. Emulator is banned. Freeze glitch is banned. Timer begins upon pressing A to enter the trophy race. Timer ends upon finishing the final lap of the final track in the trophy race.

categories.name: T.T. Amulet
categories.rules:
Collect all the pieces of the T.T. Amulet from a new Adventure 1 file.

Any character can be used, but T.T is recommended. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Resetting the console to save time is allowed. Emulator is banned. Timer starts when you enter a new file in Adventure 1. Timer stops after “1st” appears upon winning the final minigame.

categories.name: All Minigames
categories.rules: Beat all minigames in the Track mode.

categories.name: All Bosses
categories.rules:
Beat all six of DKR’s bosses.

Beat all 6 bosses. Any character can be used, but T.T is recommended. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Wrong warp is allowed but is not beneficial. Resetting to save time is allowed. Cutscene skips are allowed on all bosses. Emulator is banned. Timer starts when you enter a file in Adventure 1. Starting the run from a 100% completed file is required. No other game files may be used during the run other than the one you start with. Timer stops after “1st” appears upon defeating the 6th boss.

categories.name: Adventure 2 100%
categories.rules:
Timer starts:
- when you enter a new file in Adventure 2. 

Goal:
- Collect everything from the T.T. menu (All 47 silver Balloons, All 4 keys, All 4 pieces of the T.T. Amulet, All 4 pieces of the Wizpig Amulet, All 5 Golden Trophies). 

Timer stops:
- after crossing the finish line at Wizpig 2. 

Conditions:
- Any character can be used, but T.T is recommended. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Wrong warp is allowed. Resetting to save time is allowed. Emulator is banned.

categories.name: True 100%
categories.rules:
Complete a fresh cartridge of DKR from scratch. This includes Adventure 1 100%, Adventure 2 100%, as well as unlocking both Drumstick and T.T. the Clock.

A fresh game cartridge is required for this run, this can be acquired by resetting the game cartridge and wiping all time trial times from the time sheet in the settings menu. Timer starts when you enter a new file in Adventure 1. Collect everything from the Adventure 1 T.T. menu (All 47 Balloons, All 4 keys, All 4 pieces of the T.T. Amulet, All 4 pieces of the Wizpig Amulet, All 4 Golden Trophies) beat Wizpig 2 and the Future Fun Land Golden Trophy. Unlock Drumstick the Chicken. Unlock T.T. the Clock. Collect everything from the Adventure 2 T.T. menu and the Future Fun Land Golden Trophy. The extra balloon that is located OoB in the Smokey boss race can be collected but not substituted for any of the other 47 balloons in either Adventure 1 or 2. Timer stops after crossing the finish line at Wizpig 2 in Adventure 2. Any character can be used, but T.T is recommended once he has been unlocked. Wrong warp is allowed. Resetting to save time is allowed. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Emulator is banned.

categories.name: Car%
categories.rules: Beat all 16 tracks that are available with car in Track mode.

categories.name: Hover%
categories.rules: Beat all 20 tracks with hover in Track mode.

categories.name: Plane%
categories.rules: Beat all 11 tracks that are available with plane in Track mode.

categories.name: All Trophy Races MC
categories.rules: Complete all of the trophy races in track mode with magic codes on. Wrong warp is not allowed, nor is useful in any way. Emulator is banned. You can use any magic code. Freeze glitch is allowed.

categories.name: All Characters 100%
categories.rules:
Complete Adventure 1 100% with every character in the game in a single run.

Timer starts when you enter a new file with the first character chosen in Adventure 1. For each character, collect everything from the Adventure 1 T.T. menu (All 47 Balloons, All 4 keys, All 4 pieces of the T.T. Amulet, All 4 pieces of the Wizpig Amulet, All 4 Golden Trophies) and the Future Fun Land Golden Trophy. Timer stops after crossing the finish line at Wizpig 2 on the last character. Wrong warp is allowed. Resetting to save time is allowed, but it is mandatory that players use the ending credits to take a break between runs to stretch, eat, and use the restroom. The ending credits takes 6 minutes and 26 seconds to complete before the player can take control of the game again. All runners must wait out this time. Additional, longer breaks are encouraged, but the timer must be kept running at all times. No magic codes are allowed. Turning off music is allowed. N64-J version is recommended. Emulator is banned.

**Health Notice**: All Characters 100% is an extremely long and difficult category that takes over 20 hours to complete. We encourage all runners attempting this challenge to prepare amply and keep their physical and mental health in mind. Get plenty of sleep before starting. Ensure you have access to food and water. Take longer breaks when needed. Make sure to stand, stretch, and look away from the screen during breaks. Listen to your body and respect it. There is no shame in abandoning the run for the sake of your real-life health!
